note: The board draws the scrychat surface as the discovery-loop design proposes it, not as it is today, and pins each work item to the control that has to exist for that design to be true. A pin whose anchor is not in the mockup fails the build, so the target and the work list cannot drift apart silently.

issues.title: Deterministic goldfish sim
issues.pin: packages/core/src/goldfish.ts. mulberry32 + Fisher-Yates, no Math.random. Same deck + seed is byte-identical, which is what makes two decks comparable. 5 tests pass.

issues.title: Seed and iterations in the result
issues.pin: GoldfishResult carries seed, iterations and maxTurns, so a result is self-describing and a reader can reproduce it.

issues.title: Colour requirements
issues.pin: goldfish.ts:64 pips() reads manaCost; a cast needs cmc <= avail AND each colour's pips <= that colour's sources. Land drop takes a colour the hand demands more of than play supplies. Still optimistic: per-colour, not a matching; hybrid rides on cmc.

issues.title: Render the sim as a chart spec
issues.pin: Goldfish results render as a bar chart. goldfish_deck returns a ChartSpec from goldfishChart; parseChartSpec validates it and Chart draws it in ChatPanel.tsx.

issues.title: Compare two builds
issues.pin: The reason determinism was worth paying for. goldfish_compare runs both decks on ONE shared seed/iterations/maxTurns, echoed once at top level so the shared conditions are checkable - that echo is now on screen, because 'both decks faced identical conditions' is the whole claim. turnsToOnline is the mean turn reaching ONLINE_THRESHOLD=3 nonland casts (never-online counts maxTurns+1); delta = A - B, negative means A is faster, and it is the one field legitimately negative. Rendered by CompareTable in ui/src/ChatPanel.tsx from parseCompareSpec in ui/src/compare-core.ts, the strict sibling of chart-core.ts: untrusted tool output, null falls back to the plain tool chip. A gap under DELTA_NOISE_FLOOR=0.25 turns renders as an explicit tie, not a dimmed row - every ponytail: marker in core goldfish.ts is OPTIMISTIC in one direction, so the bias does not average away and a sub-quarter-turn delta is not a result. Scalars, not histograms, per the approved target.

issues.title: Tool chips stream live
issues.pin: tool_use at server.ts:641 opens the chip, tool-result at :664 fills it. Chat SSE, consumed by ChatPanel's reader loop.

issues.title: Ground every card claim in a fetch
issues.pin: Every card name a reply states must trace to a Scryfall fetch, shown as this chip. grounding-core.ts extracts claimed vs fetched names (tool-aware -- a deck name is not a card) and reports the residue, wired as eval B-fmt-7. RUN 2026-10-11: Tier B 5/7, 3 of 5 claims grounded, but truncatedResults=1 means the 2048-char tool-result cap can slice a real fetch out of the record, so the two flagged names are not provably hallucinations. The cap is a bare literal in 9 places -- #66 makes it one constant, then B-fmt-7 can return a verdict.

issues.title: Card hover links
issues.pin: [[Card]] from linkify-core.ts. Deterministic pass against the local name index; Haiku only for the ambiguous residue (Opt, Fog).

issues.title: Focal card images
issues.pin: ![[Card]] embeds, capped 2-3 per reply, never inside a table or list. Rubric is the systemPrompt append at server.ts:606.

issues.title: Group chips
issues.pin: [[group:...]] from group-chips-core.ts. Categories stay chips so an enumerable list does not become 11 card images.

issues.title: Photograph a binder page
issues.pin: Attach sends images as content blocks on the same turn, images first. validateImages sniffs magic bytes and rejects a declared type that disagrees, so SVG under a PNG label is refused; 4 per turn, 5mb each, never written to disk. express.json needs limit:30mb -- the 100kb default 413s a 200kb photo before validation runs.

issues.title: Suggestions as a presentation
issues.pin: Generated, not fixed: a deck suggestion has no single correct visual form. deck_present returns {kind:'slides', slides:[{title, text?, chart?}]} built from the deck's real curve, quotas and suggestion queue; slides-core.ts validates it and reuses parseChartSpec per slide. These tabs are the render. Clipped at the source so the result fits the 2048-char tool-result cap: worst case 1225 chars.

issues.title: Model-authored slide components
issues.pin: Done: a slide may carry `html`, rendered via srcdoc into an iframe with sandbox="" -- empty, not allow-scripts, verified in the production bundle. checkSlideHtml covers what the sandbox does not: outbound subresource requests and meta-refresh. An allowlist, not a sanitizer: suspect markup is rejected whole.

issues.title: Chat loop on the Agent SDK
issues.pin: Subscription auth, no per-token billing, full Claude Code tool surface subtracted from rather than built up. Do not replace with a hand-rolled loop.

issues.title: Interrupt an in-flight reply
issues.pin: POST /api/chats/:id/stop. Emits done{interrupted:true} — one of three done sites, so a shape change touches all three.

issues.title: Suggestions surface
issues.pin: Suggestions.tsx (apps/web/ui/src) inside the deck manager, desktop and phone. suggestions/<slug>.json via atomicWrite.

issues.title: Propose-only fence
issues.pin: deck_suggest never mutates. Only decideSuggestion edits, on an explicit accept. This is what lets a chat turn queue a change under permissionMode dontAsk.

issues.title: Accept / reject / note
issues.pin: Done: decideSuggestion (suggestions.ts:149) records verdict, decidedAt and an optional note; the Note... disclosure in Suggestions.tsx is what lets a human write one, and the body shape is pinned by suggestion-decide-core. Caught by a source-to-source read of this mockup on 2026-10-11: the backend, the MCP tool and the route all took a note while the UI sent a literal body "{}", so this pin had been closed on the backend alone -- the control it names did not exist.

issues.title: Why, per suggestion
issues.pin: The reasoning a human reviews. Required field — a suggestion with no why is a diff with no argument.

issues.title: Quota bars
issues.pin: deckReport at decks.ts:653. Defaults: lands 36-38, ramp 10-12, draw 10-12, interaction 8-10, wipes 2-4.

issues.title: Per-field quota override
issues.pin: resolveQuotaTargets at decks.ts:634. A deck overriding only lands keeps global values for the rest.

issues.title: Tags are an array
issues.pin: CardEntry.tags[], not one role. A card appears under every group it serves; the panel groups by tag.

issues.title: Tag editor
issues.pin: Add, remove and rename per card; a rename propagates to every card carrying that tag.

issues.title: Owned / missing from Arena
issues.pin: getOwnedIndex at collection.ts:95. Arena only; paper is out of scope. Snapshot stays local in collection.json.

issues.title: Mana curve
issues.pin: DeckReport.curve. Updates live as the deck panel changes.

issues.title: Export, three formats
issues.pin: MTGA trims Front // Back to the front face; Arena's importer rejects the full name. Fenced by export-fence.test.ts.

issues.title: Hosted code execution
issues.pin: The discovery feature: answers questions no pre-written tool covers. Runs in Anthropic's sandbox, not on this host, so it cannot reach decks/ or data/. NOT Bash.

issues.title: Expose the seed in settings
issues.pin: A fixed seed keeps two runs comparable, so the determinism contract is now visible instead of implicit. Shipped as a number input plus Randomize, not a slider: a seed is an identifier, not a magnitude. The value rides the config file into the sim, because the server injects no tool arguments.

issues.title: linkifyPass toggle
issues.pin: scrychat.config.json, PATCH /api/config. Keep the two-stage gate: removing it costs an extra model call on every reply.

issues.title: Health endpoint
issues.pin: GET /api/health reports skill readability and whether the mirror has cards and Arena data. Check it before re-diagnosing 'not finding cards'.

issues.title: Mirror row count and local-hit share
issues.pin: scrychat.db is empty and until now nothing said so. GET /api/health tells absent / present-but-empty / populated apart (cardCount 0 means empty, null undeterminable) plus usableAsMirror for whether lookups actually go local; getLocalDb() conflates absent with empty by design for its fallback callers, so health stats the file and counts via core readLocalDbCounts (read-only, fileMustExist, never creates). This pill now renders it: healthPills() in apps/web/src/health-pills.ts, drawn by ui/src/HealthRow.tsx. A populated mirror with usableAsMirror false reads warn, not ok, because lookups still leave the machine. Verified live: this machine renders warn 'mirror: empty'. The local-hit SHARE is still not measured anywhere - collection lookups batch 75 ids per POST /cards/collection and search does not batch at all - but that is a counter, not this pill.

issues.title: Stale-snapshot warning
issues.pin: An Arena snapshot ages silently and owned/missing goes quietly wrong. GET /api/health returns a collection block (freshness, ageDays, label, staleAfterDays=14) computed from the file's own importedAt, never mtime, which any rewrite would reset. The pill now renders it via healthPills(): fresh ok, stale warn, a future date warn as clock skew, no snapshot dim. The 14-day threshold is quoted from the server's staleAfterDays instead of kept as a second client copy that can drift. Verified live: with no snapshot on disk this machine renders dim 'arena: none'.

issues.title: Replace the real UI with this target
issues.pin: This board tracks the goal; it is not the goal. This pin is the tracked item that retires the mockup. The board itself shipped in f78993d (tools/progress/).

issues.title: Make the tool-result cap one constant
issues.pin: Closed by exporting TOOL_RESULT_MAX_CHARS (server.ts) and mirroring it as TOOL_RESULT_BUDGET_CHARS in packages/mcp/src/present-budget.ts, pinned by test/present-budget.test.ts (9 tests). The issue's own premise was wrong: the number appears 12 times, of which 1 is the declaration, 3 are test assertions and 8 are comment prose -- no validator reads a second literal. The real defect was different and live: the per-field caps (title 40, text 320, html 1600) are all satisfiable by a payload that still overflows the 2048 WHOLE-RESULT budget, because nothing measured the serialized result. Measured 2026-10-11: all five quotas OFF + full curve + long pending = 2223 chars while the html slide sits at 1117 of its 1600 cap. Overflow was silent (truncated JSON -> parseSlideSpec null -> plain chip). deck_present now calls fitPresentSlides, dropping whole low-priority slides and never the first. Live decks measured over the real stdio server: grothama 1779, isshin 1618, both parse after a 2048 slice.

issues.title: B-fmt-3 regressed: chips unpopulated
issues.pin: These chips should arrive populated from the server. B-fmt-3 passed in the recorded 6/6 Tier B run and now reports populatedChips=0 with sample=null -- none populated at all, so it reads as the fill path being gone rather than a format drift. Found while running B-fmt-7 for #47; not investigated.

issues.title: No Present trigger
issues.pin: Done: a Present button in the composer row posts PRESENT_PROMPT through the existing send(override) path, and the SlideStrip renderer (#56) draws the result. Deliberately NOT in #slide-strip where this mockup draws it: SlideStrip exists only after deck_present has returned, so a trigger there is reachable only after the thing it starts. Disabled without an active deck, since the model learns the deck solely from the server's activeDeck context line (server.ts:486) and deck_present requires deck_name.

issues.title: No pin-to-artifact parity gate
issues.pin: check_anchors proves a pin's anchor exists in THIS mockup; --audit proves the board matches the tracker. Neither opens the artifact. Mockup declares 58 ids, the real UI source has 8 (it keys off className), so a naive diff yields 52 false positives -- which is how #sug-actions stayed closed with its note control missing.

off_board.44: Data error in two generated deck pages, not a target control: regenerate them. The behaviour that caused it is tracked by #47.
off_board.63: Research notes on card-similarity approaches, and the conclusion is to build nothing yet: otag already encodes function, which an oracle-text embedding would duplicate worse. No control follows until that changes.
off_board.64: A competitive analysis of other AI deckbuilders. It argues what the product already is, so it pins to no new control; where it names a gap, that gap gets its own issue.
off_board.65: A feature inventory of one competitor, filling the undisclosed cells in #64's table. Its output is a doc and a correction diff, so it changes no control here; anything it turns into product work gets its own issue.
